From the owner
Last Chance! Free Kitchen Remodeling Seminar This Thursday
Oct 15, 6:00 PM - 7:30 PM
Still thinking about remodeling your indoor or outdoor kitchen? There's still time to reserve your seat for our complimentary kitchen remodeling seminar! Join the Gayler Design Build team for an evening of practical remodeling advice, answers to your questions, and insights to help you plan with confidence. Plus, enjoy sandwiches from Domenico's Delicatessen and Cafe, refreshments, and a chance to win a bottle of Rombauer Carneros Chardonnay! Thursday, October 15 | 6:00 PM Gayler Design Build Showroom 825 Hartz Way, Danville Only two days away! Don't miss this opportunity to get your remodeling questions answered.
